text:
tom: Kicking off canary deploy now for release v1.9.3. Feature flag `new-routing-v2` will be toggled to 1% for canary cohort A. Monitoring hooks in place. :eyes:
deploy-bot: deploy started to canary-A (hosts: a1,a2). Flag toggle scheduled: 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 30m windows. Health checks: latency, 5xx, regen-rate.
maya: tagging QA to run smoke + replay on canary traffic. @jen can you confirm load-replay script?
jen: running replay now, will post a short log snippet if anything odd.
ops-bot: note — pinning model variant `lm-7b-q4` for this rollout to avoid perf drift.
dmitri: keep an eye on kv-cache eviction metric, last time that tripped at 10% traffic.
qa-bot: smoke tests green for canary-A after 3m. responses within SLO.
jen: small error bump on a2 at +9m (0.9%->1.8%), investigating stack traces, pushing logs to #incidents if persists.
maya: pause ramp to 1% holdpoint. do not progress to 5% until we confirm root cause. :hand:
deploy-bot: ramp paused by manual holdpoint (maya). Current flag state: 1%.
dmitri: quick rollback plan: if error rate >2% for 10m, toggle flag off and revert routing to stable. Who is owner for rollback?
jen: I can flip the flag and initiate rollback script `scripts/rolloff.sh`. tagging @dmitri to monitor infra.
maya: agreed. jen you have the go for rollback if error rate stays >2% for another 6m. notify #eng-oncall and product.
dmitri: noted. setting dashboard threshold alert to 1.5% so we get ahead.
jen: logs indicate malformed prompt edge-case from earlier change; not infra. I think a flag-off will stop surface errors.
maya: ok perform a soft disable (set new-routing-v2=0 for canary cohort) and keep canary hosts available for further debug. report back once done.
jen: executed: `curl -X POST https://flags.api/toggle -d '{"flag":"new-routing-v2","cohort":"canary-A","pct":0}'` -> 200. flag is now 0% on canary-A.
deploy-bot: flag update applied. Canary traffic reverted to stable routing.
qa-bot: post-disable smoke run shows errors back to baseline.
maya: thanks. capture a brief blurb for release notes: "Hold on `new-routing-v2` in canary due to prompt-edge errors; rollback applied and investigating." I'll prep a short note.
dmitri: good job. when root cause confirmed, we can plan a smaller experiment (0.5% with explicit input sanitization) before ramping.
jen: filing a follow-up ticket with reproducer and patch candidate. will link to this thread. :memo:
maya: closing holdpoint. leave deploy paused until patch is validated. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
